entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: I would never have imagined that their[n]leader would commit suicide.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: Akechi-kun, did you... anticipate this[n]curious turn of events?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, certainly not to this extent...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But it is important to note that he was[n]the mastermind behind the recent[n]commotion.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Getting captured must have wounded[n]his pride irreparably. Such things happen[n]often to insurgent leaders.

entries.speaker: Cute Announcer
entries.en: According to the police, the whereabouts[n]of the other members are still currently[n]unknown.

entries.speaker: Cute Announcer
entries.en: Considering they no longer require[n]testimony from the leader, the[n]investigation will be hard to—

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: May I butt in for a second?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: Of course.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves may have laid low[n]since then... but they must not be excused!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't care if they come after me! For the[n]victims of their evil deeds, and for their[n]families...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I will capture the remaining Phantom[n]Thieves, no matter what!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...My apologies. I didn't mean to get so[n]worked up.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: No wonder they call you an ace detective[n]of justice! What passion!

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: How about we use this opportunity to[n]poll the audience?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: Those who believe the detective of justice[n]will annihilate the Phantom Thieves, press[n]your buttons now!

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: My, everyone in the audience agrees!

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: Looks like you can't back down now.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I will do the best I can.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Oh, but I do have to study for my college[n]entrance exams. I might not be able to[n]promise that...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: None of these people know that I was[n]an undesirable child.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I wanted people to rely on me... I wanted[n]to be needed...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I devoted myself to my studies, acted as[n]an honor student, and made my name[n]as an ace detective.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And thanks to the Nav app and the[n]Persona bestowed upon me by the gods...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I managed to dispose of any who got in[n]my way.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Though it took me some time to finally[n]do so...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...All that remains is to tell him.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: But still, wasn't their leader's suicide[n]a letdown for you, given how long it[n]took to apprehend him?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: I think if it were me, I would've collapsed[n]from the shock.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: True...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It did make me feel somewhat dizzy...[n]Just a little though.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps my mind was worked up due to[n]the major task I had undertaken...

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: Hey, who is that!? If you don't turn off[n]your phone, the Phantom Thieves might[n]change your heart!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...A phone?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: See? Even Akechi-kun's face has[n]stiffened up.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A-Ah, sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm not bothered. Just make sure to[n]turn it off when you go to the movies!
